name: VideoGen MCP
description: Official VideoGen MCP server for creating and editing videos, images, voiceovers, music, and avatars. Local stdio and hosted HTTP with OAuth or API keys. Website: https://videogen.io/videogen-mcp
examples: Create ecommerce product-marketing videos from a storyboard.
Generate images and voiceovers, then edit and export a video project.

requirements.other: Local stdio: VIDEOGEN_API_KEY. Hosted HTTP: https://mcp.videogen.io/mcp with OAuth or API key. Generation requires account credits.

features: Image, video, voiceover, music, and avatar generation
Media uploads, project editing, and video exports
Hosted Streamable HTTP and local stdio
